summary: Greenland Energy Company filed an 8-K disclosing a Deed of Variation and Novation dated September 23, 2026 with 80 Mile plc (AIM: 80M) and its subsidiary March GL Company, amending the September 9, 2025 Farm-Out Agreement covering oil exploration licenses and drilling in Greenland's Jameson Land Basin. March GL assigned its rights and obligations to the parent; first-well and second-well longstop dates extend to December 31, 2028, and the Company assumes all permit obligations. Consideration is a $500,000 cash payment due within five business days. This is a routine joint-venture contract amendment and Regulation FD disclosure, not a special situation; watch permitting and drilling execution risk.
